description: Error analysis of scoring v9 (runs/20261003-eval-test-v9), added on 2026-10-03: every false positive (误标), false negative (漏标) and abstention (待审) of every v9 system put in a category by the fixed mechanical rules written in src/novel_ner/errors.py (nobody judges whether an answer is right); the new-name result both per occurrence (pre-registered, evaluate's new_name_recall, re-derived and checked) and per distinct name (post hoc). generic_words is the list of the annotation guide v1.1 rule A1 copied exactly (the program checks it against docs/annotation_guide/v1.1.md); the computed task text also named 她, 你 and 我, which A1 does not list, so they are not in it. title_suffixes, category_words and grade_category_pattern are read from configs/weak_v2.json (the same words the weak-label conversions K1 and K3 use). Models pool runs and seeds as in the v9 scoring config.
